item.title: We should be more tired than the model
item.description:
📝 We should be more tired than the modelMay 28 2026Lately, I’ve been feeling like I’m losing control over the code I write when I work with agentic code generation. Short-term memory gathers information temporarily and processes it quickly, like RAM. Working memory takes the information from short-term memory and long-term memory and combines them to synthesize, or process the information and come up with a solution.
🔗 Read more: https://vickiboykis.com/2026/05/28/we-should-be-more-tired-than-the-model/
